chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Fazzal, from Al-Hasan ibn Al-Jaham, who said:
Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) showed me an iron needle (kohl applicator) and a kohl container made of bone, and he said: 'This was for Abu Al-Hasan, so apply kohl with it,' and I applied kohl.

key_terms.مِيلًا: A long, thin needle used for applying kohl to the eyes

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Al-Hasan show to the narrator regarding kohl application?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* illustrates the Shia concept of *al-Tabarruk* (seeking blessings through physical contact with the Imams), where Imam Al-Hasan (AS) gifts his personal kohl (*kuhl*) to the narrator, Hasan ibn al-Jahm. The specific mention of the iron needle and bone container underscores the tangible nature of these relics, linking the narrator directly to the lineage of the Ahl al-Bayt and validating the spiritual merit of using items previously owned or used by the Imams.
